name: Drusilla
source:
Follow Samuel as he explores every corner of Thorngrove Manor and tries to uncover the secrets of Lady Drusilla Wickhart. Solve puzzles and investigate an intriguing story as Samuel is pulled into a plot of unbridled lust, ambition, dangerous rituals and a thirst for youth and beauty.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/73233617]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
跟随Samuel探索Thorngrove庄园的每个角落，揭开Drusilla Wickhart夫人的秘密。解开谜题、调查引人入胜的故事；Samuel将被卷入一场充斥着放纵欲望、野心、危险仪式，以及对青春与美貌的渴望的阴谋。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/73233617]Patreon[/url]]
